nodes.description: Caller-controlled address returned by _msgSender(); drives ownership checks and transfer origin.
Miner-influenced timestamp used for cooldown, private sale limits, anti-bot block window and Uniswap deadlines.
Core private transfer routine handling fees, cooldowns, max wallet/sell limits and marketing swap trigger.
Private lockTheSwap routine that swaps contract tokens for ETH and distributes marketing/dev/liquidity ETH.
Private helper that pushes ETH to a fee wallet via transfer().
Private helper approving and swapping tokens for ETH through the Uniswap V2 router.
Private helper that adds token/ETH liquidity to the Uniswap pair via the router.
Only-owner function enabling trading, excluding rewards and setting launchedAt.
Only-owner function replacing the Uniswap router and pair, possibly creating a new pair.
Only-owner function draining the whole contract ETH balance to an arbitrary recipient.
Only-owner function transferring arbitrary ERC20 balances held by the contract.
Public only-owner function pushing an account into the reward-excluded list.
Only-owner batch airdrop looping _transfer over a caller-supplied address array.
Only-owner function mutating buy fees and global totalFee.
Only-owner function mutating sell fee configuration.
Private dispatcher selecting reflection/excluded transfer variants and toggling fees.
ERC20 transferFrom that transfers then decrements allowance.
Public function burning reflection from the caller and increasing _tFeeTotal.
Public flag gating transfers and enabling swap/limit logic.
Block number when trading launched; drives max-wallet window and anti-bot 99% tax.
Reentrancy guard flag set by lockTheSwap modifier.
Public flag enabling per-holder sell cooldowns.
Mapping of holder to next allowed sell timestamp.
Public flag enabling private sale daily sell caps.
Mapping of private sale holder to last recorded sell timestamp.
Mapping of private sale holder to accumulated ETH sold in the window.
Aggregated liquidity+marketing+dev fee used for swap math.
Contract token balance threshold that triggers the marketing swap.
Maximum wallet holding limit enforced inside _transfer.
Maximum single sell amount enforced on pair sells.
Trusted/owner-settable Uniswap V2 router used for swaps and liquidity.
Uniswap pair address used for buy/sell detection and pair operations.
Payable marketing wallet receiving ETH fees.
Payable dev wallet receiving ETH fees.
Owner flag zeroing buy taxes when enabled.
Reflection share balances mapping modified by every transfer path.
Total token supply constant used to derive limits.
Total reflection supply decreased by fees.
Mapping of addresses exempt from transfer fees.
Owner-settable ETH cap per private sale window.
Owner-settable cooldown interval applied to cooldownTimer.
Low-level ETH transfer() to a payable fee wallet, executed before full state settlement.
External call to Uniswap router swapExactTokensForETHSupportingFeeOnTransferTokens with amountOutMin 0.
External call to Uniswap router addLiquidityETH with zero slippage minimums.
transfer() of the entire contract balance to an owner-supplied address.
External ERC20 transfer() of contract-held token balance to an owner-supplied address.
External call to the Uniswap factory createPair with a caller/owner-supplied router, creating and trusting a new pair.
Only-owner ownership hand-off guarded function.
Only-owner function setting cooldown status and interval with a 24h bound.
Alternate private swap routine that also burns pair tokens and calls sync().
New owner address argument of transferOwnership.
Amount argument of _transfer/transfer flows.
Boolean status argument of openTrading.
Token amount argument of swapTokensForEth.
Local balance-of-contract value compared to swapThreshold and passed to swapTokens.
Recipient argument of withDrawLeftoverETH.
Destination address argument of withdrawStuckTokens.
New router address argument of setNewRouter.
ETH amount argument of sendETHToFee.
Payable wallet argument of sendETHToFee.
Local fee variable reused to override taxes for buy/sell/anti-bot paths.
Local liquidity token portion computed inside swapTokens.
Base-1000 percent argument used to recompute _maxWalletToken.
Address array argument of send_airdrops.

edges.reason: openTrading is gated by onlyOwner which compares _owner to _msgSender(); caller identity controls privileged state change.
setNewRouter is onlyOwner and lets the caller swap the router/pair used by all swaps.
withDrawLeftoverETH is onlyOwner and drains the entire ETH balance to a caller-chosen address.
withdrawStuckTokens is onlyOwner and moves arbitrary ERC20 balances out of the contract.
excludeFromReward is onlyOwner and mutates the exclusion list with caller-supplied account.
send_airdrops is onlyOwner and executes many transfers from the owner balance.
setTaxesBuy is onlyOwner and changes critical fee state used by every transfer.
setTaxesSell is onlyOwner and changes sell fee state.
transferOwnership is onlyOwner; the owner can hand control to any address.
changeCooldownSettings is onlyOwner and rewrites sell cooldown parameters.
transfer() passes _msgSender() as the from argument into _transfer.
Caller address flows through _transfer into _tokenTransfer as sender.
transferFrom uses _msgSender() as spender for the allowance decrement.
Cooldown, private sale delay and anti-bot logic depend on block.timestamp, allowing miner-influenced gating.
block.timestamp is passed as the Uniswap swap deadline, so the operation depends on miner-controlled time.
block.timestamp is passed as the addLiquidityETH deadline, making liquidity addition time dependent.
Cooldown interval is bounded against block-derived duration constants set by owner input.
Sell path calls swapTokens (which performs external ETH transfers) before the underlying token transfer settles.
swapTokens transfers ETH out via sendETHToFee while the swap guard is held only by inSwap.
sendETHToFee performs wallet.transfer(), an external ETH call that can execute recipient code.
swapTokens calls addLiquidity, triggering external router calls during fee processing.
swapTokens calls swapTokensForEth which makes an external router swap call.
swapTokensForEth invokes the router swap with deadline block.timestamp and amountOutMin 0, an external call.
addLiquidity invokes the router addLiquidityETH external call with zero slippage minimums.
setNewRouter calls factory createPair, making the pair address owner-controlled and external.
withDrawLeftoverETH performs transfer() of the whole balance, an external ETH send.
withdrawStuckTokens performs an external ERC20 transfer() whose token may execute code.
_transfer delegates the actual balance mutation to _tokenTransfer.
calculatedTotalFee is assigned from sell/buy/anti-bot fee expressions inside _transfer.
Global totalFee feeds the fee math applied on every transfer.
contractTokenBalance is computed from balanceOf(address(this)) inside _transfer.
The computed contractTokenBalance is passed into swapTokens.
swapThreshold controls whether the in-transfer swap trigger fires.
tradingOpen gates transfers and enables the sell/swap branch in _transfer.
launchedAt participates in launchedAt+2 window comparisons and anti-bot tax assignment.
cooldownEnabled gates writing of cooldownTimer during sells.
cooldownTimer[from] is read and written with block.timestamp inside _transfer.
privateSaleLimitsEnabled conditionally blocks the entire private sale restriction branch.
privateSaleSellTime is compared and updated with block.timestamp in limit math.
privateSaleSold is accumulated and compared to privateSaleMaxDailySell.
privateSaleMaxDailySell caps the ETH value of private sale holder sells.
_maxWalletToken bounds amount + balanceOf(to) during transfers.
_maxSellLimit bounds the amount sold to the pair.
zeroBuyTaxmode can zero out the buy tax for pair-originated transfers.
uniswapV2Pair is compared against from/to to detect swaps and enable fees.
swapTokensForEth approves and calls the address stored in uniswapV2Router.
marketingWallet receives ETH via sendETHToFee, making the payout target a mutable external address.
devWallet receives ETH via sendETHToFee, an owner-settable payable destination.
_rOwned balances are read and written by every transfer variant reached from _transfer.
_tTotal is used to derive max wallet and sell limits compared in _transfer.
_rTotal is reduced by fees when transfers settle, affecting rate math.
swapTokenswithoutImpact calls swapTokensForEth, an external swap, inside its guarded routine.
swapTokenswithoutImpact re-enters _transfer to burn pair tokens before sync.
totalFee is used as divisor in swapTokens distribution math, a division-by-zero/rounding surface.
cooldownTimerInterval is added to block.timestamp to write cooldownTimer.
_isExcludedFromFee determines whether takeFee is enabled in _transfer.
inSwap short-circuits the private sale and swap branches of _transfer.
The amount parameter flows into _transfer balance math.
openTrading status parameter is written directly into tradingOpen.
tokenAmount parameter is approved and forwarded to the router swap.
recipient parameter becomes the transfer destination in the leftover ETH drain.
to parameter becomes the destination of the stuck-token ERC20 transfer.
newRouter parameter drives factory/pair resolution including createPair.
amount parameter becomes the value of the ETH transfer to a fee wallet.
wallet parameter is the payable destination of the ETH transfer.
amountToLiquify computed in swapTokens is later used to add liquidity.
maxWallPercent_base1000 argument recomputes _maxWalletToken without an upper bound.
The addresses array parameter controls the loop of transfers in send_airdrops.
newOwner parameter is written into the owner storage slot.

normalization_plan.reason: The newOwner argument exists only to be validated and stored by transferOwnership, so it should be folded into that core function node.
The transfer amount is consumed exclusively by _transfer fee and limit math and has no independent semantics.
The status flag is written straight into tradingOpen inside openTrading and carries no separate identity.
The token amount is used only for approval and the router swap call inside swapTokensForEth.
The local balance is computed and immediately forwarded into swapTokens, so it belongs with that core operation.
The recipient address is only the destination of the owner-gated ETH drain.
The destination address exists solely for the stuck-token transfer triggered by withdrawStuckTokens.
The router argument is consumed by setNewRouter to resolve the factory and pair.
The amount is the value field of the ETH transfer performed by sendETHToFee.
The wallet is the payable target of the ETH transfer performed by sendETHToFee.
This local is a mutable copy of fee state used only within _transfer branches.
The value is derived and consumed entirely inside swapTokens distribution math.
The address array drives the transfer loop of send_airdrops and has no meaning outside it.
